tiles.headline: Warm Yin
tiles.sub: Class of the month · Fridays at 6:45pm
tiles.body: A slower end to the week. Sink into deep stretches in a gently heated room, giving your body time to soften, release and reset. Fridays at 6:45pm · 45 mins.

tiles.headline: Next 5 week block starting!
tiles.body: Join us from the 18th Oct- 15th Nov every Sunday with Katie, who specialises in prenatal yoga. Ease the aches, build strength for birth, and meet other mums-to-be. Suitable from 14 weeks to full term.

tiles.headline: Nervous about your first class?
tiles.sub: Latest read · 5 ways to feel calm
tiles.body: First-class nerves are completely normal. Five simple ways to feel calm and ready before you step on the mat.

tiles.headline: Try the whole studio for £35
tiles.body: Twenty-one days of classes for £35. Every style, every teacher, no commitment. The easiest way to start.

tiles.headline: Hot class? Bring a towel
tiles.sub: Studio news · What to bring to the heat
tiles.body: Every hot class needs a towel long enough to cover your mat. Rent one at the studio for £4 or buy your own for £28. Mat rental is £2 a class.
